title: Hold a licence to explore for or recover minerals offshore
what: Exploring for or recovering minerals in a Commonwealth offshore area needs a licence or special purpose consent.

sources.title: Offshore Minerals Act 1994
sources.quote: A person must not: (a) explore for minerals in an offshore area; or (b) recover minerals from an offshore area; unless the exploration or recovery is authorised by a licence or special purpose consent granted under this Act.
